rationale:
design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger)

P5 is a Pulp-only Phase 2 carve prerequisite: content_registry implementation and its public header move into the new pulp-content target while preserving the pulp/state include path and the existing pulp::state consumer surface. The concrete pulp-state archive loses its sample-bank-manifest direct edge and retains only runtime plus events; pulp-content carries the sample-bank-manifest dependency transitively. This is a zero-behavior-change target decomposition, with no Vellum consumption, no deletion of a Pulp implementation, and no generic Vellum implementation claim.
